subject: SLO evidence exchange & measurement definitions — p50/p95 mapping
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@stratuspay.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SLO evidence exchange & measurement definitions — p50/p95 mapping

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear the StratusPay team is ramping pilots this quarter. Per our discussion, I wanted to put a short, concrete plan in writing so Procurement and SRE have something to reference while we finalize terms.

High-level ask: we need an agreed definition of what counts as valid "evidence" for a temporary SLO derating or carveout, plus an exact mapping of the p50/p95 SLOs to API surface areas (auth, shortText, longText, streaming). That mapping will live in the SLA addendum.

Proposed handshake items (attached draft checklist + doc):
- Measurement scope: service endpoints grouped into 4 buckets (Auth, Embeddings, Short-Form Gen <512 tokens, Long-Form Gen >=512 tokens).
- Quantiles: p50 and p95 computed on per-route request latency (end-to-end, client-to-response), sampled across the full customer footprint with our standard weighting.
- Windowing: 30-min aggregation windows for realtime alerts; 24-hour rolling window for operational evidence; 7-day window for contractual breaches.
- Burst carveout trigger: evidence package required for any temporary derating >12 hours due to traffic spikes.
- Evidence package items: request logs (redacted), histogram of latencies by route, ingress origin distribution, and a short remediation timeline.

Action items for StratusPay: please confirm the API route buckets above or attach your preferred mapping by end of day Monday. Once we have that we will produce the formal addendum language and the evidence checklist for signatures.

I've attached a draft "redwood_slo-evidence-checklist.pdf" and a "measurement-window-proposal-v1.docx" to make it easier.

If useful, Karthik can jump on a quick 30-min tech call with David to walk the evidence extraction steps.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Platform Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_slo-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF), measurement-window-proposal-v1.docx (DOCX)

From: Emma Torres <emma@stratuspay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stratuspay.com>, David Hsu <david.hsu@stratuspay.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLO evidence exchange & measurement definitions — p50/p95 mapping

Neha, thanks for the summary and the docs — this is exactly the level of detail Procurement wanted. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Route buckets: we approve the 4-bucket approach but want "Short-Form Gen" split into <256 tokens and 256-512 tokens. That matters for our billing and tail behavior.
- Windowing: Procurement asks whether "24-hour rolling window for operational evidence" is raw data or aggregated metrics. We need raw histograms exported for at least the 24-hour window.
- Burst carveout: we are OK with a derating trigger but request a maximum derating period of 72 hours without mutual written agreement. After 72 hours, automatic escalation to a joint incident review.

We can confirm the mapping in a shared sheet by Monday. David is available Wed 07 Dec 10am PT if Karthik wants to do the tech walkthrough.

Emma
Emma Torres
Sr. Program Manager, Platform Reliability
StratusPay

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Torres <emma@stratuspay.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLO evidence exchange & measurement definitions — p50/p95 mapping

Emma / Neha — thanks for the responses. A few technical notes to align expectations before the Wed call:

1) Raw histograms: we can provide per-route latency histograms with percentile bins (1ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms, 1s, 2s). We will redact client IPs and tokens; we will include origin region and customer request id.

2) Sampling & weighting: our default weighting is uniform per-request; for routing-heavy customers we can apply ingress-weighted aggregation so that bursty origins show up correctly in the evidence package. This will be noted in the addendum.

3) Derating duration: 72 hours is reasonable as an operational cap, but we propose a procedural clause: any derating >24 hours requires a documented mitigation plan; >72 hours triggers a joint remediation and potential temporary crediting. We'll capture both thresholds in the addendum draft.

4) Measurement timestamp alignment: all exported metrics will be in UTC ISO timestamps and include the server-side processing time and total end-to-end latency.

I'll join Wed 07 Dec 10am PT. Neha — can you share the shared sheet and the HubSpot deal link to procurement?

—Kar
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Reliability & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@stratuspay.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLO evidence exchange & measurement definitions — p50/p95 mapping

Hi all — looping in a short commercial note from Procurement/Sales alignment so legal has a clean handoff:

- We will incorporate the 4 buckets with the extra Short-Form split Emma requested.
- The addendum will define: metric definitions (client->server timing), aggregation windows (30m alerting, 24h evidence export, 7d contractual cadence), sampling policy, and a stepwise derating procedure (24h mitigation plan, 72h maximum w/ joint review).
- Evidence package required artifacts: redacted request logs, per-route histograms, ingress distribution, proposed mitigation timeline, and any third-party provider incident reports.
- Credit mechanics: if a derating continues past the review window, we will bias crediting toward service-month pro rata until a mutual resolution. Exact credit formula to be negotiated in legal.

Next steps: Neha, please produce the addendum draft (we'll use the attached checklist as the spec), and share the HubSpot deal id (I added it to related links). Emma — once you confirm the final route grouping in the shared sheet, we'll lock the addendum for Legal review.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
